literal_meaning: তুলার পাল্লা ভারী (the pan of the scale is heavy)
figurative_meaning_en: High degree of possibility or likelihood
similar_in_english: Tip the scales in one's favor
The odds are stacked against/in favor
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পক্ষে পাল্লা ভারী, তাই সে জিতবে।
example_sentences_in_english: The scales are heavy in his favor, so he will win.
The project's success has heavy odds.
note: Refers to the imagery of a weighing scale tipping due to weight, symbolizing advantage in chances.
